sn45.30:1.2: atha kho āyasmā uttiyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā uttiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn45.30:1.3: idha mayhaṃ bhante, rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi.
sn45.30:1.5: katame nu kho pañca kāmaguṇā vuttā bhagavatāti.
sn45.30:1.7: pañcakho me uttiya, kāmaguṇā vuttā mayā.
sn45.30:1.9: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā,
sn45.30:1.13: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn45.30:1.14: ime kho uttiya, pañca kāmaguṇā vuttā mayā.
sn45.30:1.15: imesaṃ kho uttiya, pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo.
sn45.30:1.18: imesaṃ kho uttiya, pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ pahānāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabboti.
